title: Go loop surfaces runner failures instead of spinning silently
notes: On 2026-08-23 the monthly spend limit killed every runner instantly; the loop claimed, failed, reset, and re-claimed 3,959 times over 13 hours while the dashboard showed Running the whole time. Fix three things: (1) treat a runner that exits non-zero without finalizing its task as a FAILURE, recording the exit code and the last stderr line into status.json so the dashboard can show it; (2) back off exponentially and stop re-claiming the same task after N consecutive failures, parking it with a clear reason; (3) show a loop-unhealthy state on the dashboard Summary hero (consecutive failures, last error) so a stalled loop never reads as Running. Acceptance: simulate a runner that always exits non-zero and confirm the dashboard says unhealthy with the error text, the loop stops hot-retrying, and history records one failure event per attempt rather than 3,959 resets.
